changes.text: 必须说清楚：本篇所有数字与叙述都出自斯诺本人的书和表格。死者住址来自登记总署。8月26日以后，各区登记员应登记总长的要求，填报了霍乱死亡病例发病房屋的供水情况。这些填报并不完整，仍有一批个案的供水没有查明。斯诺写道，这些填报与他对疫情早期的调查结果“完全一致”。这算是来自登记数据的部分印证，不过我们也只是通过斯诺的书才知道这一点。另外，调查并非全部出自斯诺之手：伯蒙德西等一些只由南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水的地区，是由医生约翰·约瑟夫·怀廷（John Joseph Whiting）去调查的。怀廷的调查只覆盖疫情头四周（7月8日至8月5日），查的是死亡发生的房屋接的是公司的水、自家水井还是别的水源；在部分这类分区，后三周的供水是按头四周的比例推算的，并非逐户查得。即便如此，学说、统计的整理以及呈现它们的这本书都出自斯诺；表九的户数基数来自1853年的议会报表，14周统计中两家公司供水户的人口是登记总长的估计数。这不意味着数据有错，但意味着我们读到的是一方的记录。

Plainly: every figure and every account in this piece comes from Snow's own book and his own tables. The addresses of the dead came from the General Register Office. After 26 August the district registrars, at the Registrar General's request, returned the water supply of the house of attack in cholera deaths. The returns were incomplete, and the supply "remained unascertained in a number of cases". Even so, Snow says they "agree entirely" with the results of his inquiry into the earlier part of the epidemic. That is partial corroboration from registration data, though it reaches us only through Snow's book. Nor was the whole inquiry Snow's own work. A medical man, John Joseph Whiting, made the inquiries in Bermondsey and certain other districts supplied only by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company. Whiting's part covered only the first four weeks of the epidemic, from 8 July to 5 August, and asked whether each house had the company's water, a pump-well or some other source; in some of these sub-districts the water supply of the last three weeks was calculated in the same proportion as in the first four weeks, not ascertained house by house. Still, the doctrine, the compilation of the statistics and the book that presents them are all Snow's; the house counts behind Table IX come from a return made to Parliament for 1853, and the populations of the houses supplied by the two companies in the 14-week figures were estimated by the Registrar General. That does not make the data wrong, but it does mean we are reading one side's record.

dispositions.rationale: 原段末把统计整体归于斯诺，与证据不符。现收窄为斯诺负责“统计的整理”，并注明两点：表九的户数基数来自1853年的议会报表，14周统计中两家公司供水户的人口是登记总长的估计数。中英文同步修改，ev 补入 W-E14 和 W-E17。

evidence.quote: According to a return which was made to Parliament, the Southwark and Vauxhall Company supplied 40,046 houses from January 1st to December 31st, 1853
where the population of the houses supplied by the two water companies is that estimated by the Eegistrar General.
I was fortunate enough to obtain the assistance of a medical man, Mr. John Joseph Whiting, L.A.C.
